operations.description: Add separate S and Cd stocks with specified anneals and evolving Cd:OA ratios. Elemental sulfur and Cd-oleate stocks are in OD. Stock preparation details, stock volume and per-layer delivered volumes are not supplied. For the first 5–8 shell deposition cycles use Cd:oleic acid 1:4; use 1:10 for each succeeding layer. The exact switch cycle is not fixed. Grow at 240 °C, waiting one hour after sulfur and 2.5 hours after cadmium, until the desired shell thickness. This preferred protocol is separate from Table 1 comparison schedules. Missing fields: per-layer doses, exact switch cycle.
